description: Google Workspace connector: explicit-account access through a local MCP bridge, read-only by default, and the Google Calendar sync into meetings.

dreamteamer.title: Google Workspace connector
dreamteamer.description: Access an explicitly selected Google account through a local workspace-mcp process — a fixed read-only tool set by default, no call without a stored credential, credentials kept outside the workspace — and sync work calendars into `meetings` records (`/fetch-meetings`). Two setup units: `google-workspace` (the account) and `meetings` (`WORK_CALENDARS`). Authorize each account per computer.
